rationale: The November 6 advisory lists Enterprise 10.0 bundled Node.js as affected and 9.4 and 10.2+ as unaffected by that runtime issue. UF is unaffected. The 10.2+ upgrade does not address Visual Exporter, which has a separate disable/remove mitigation. SOAR Automation Broker, Observability Cloud and OpenTelemetry Collector are affected with remediation in progress and no fixed build stated here. Synthetic Runner has its own 1.71.0+ recommendation.

products: Splunk Enterprise, Forwarders, SOAR and Observability
exclusions: No exact unlisted pairing, rollout, entitlement or customer authorization is established.
